notes: Single sorbent measured for H2: acid/baked ozonized HiPco SWNTs (sample 4); volumetric method at NREL, 77 K (also 'liquid nitrogen temperatures'). Figure 5 shows five measured points (diamonds) up to about 3.5 bar plus a Langmuir-Freundlich fit that reaches about 3 wt% at 30 bar; the '3 wt % at 77 K and 30 bar' value lies beyond the last measured point and is read from the fit. Uptake basis not stated. SSA of sample 4 after acid/bake is 1068 m2/g (N2 multipoint BET, Micromeritics ASAP 2010); 381 m2/g before. The 2.4 wt% value for purified SWNTs is quoted from ref. 29 and is not the paper's own. No statement that the 3 wt% value was published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. record.json is_retracted is false and the text carries no retraction notice. Full article is an original research article in English.
